recognize_zh: EBER 原位雜交在粉紅色背景中，深藍黑色的陽性細胞核圍繞著中央一條血管排列成環狀，部分侵入管壁；EBV 陽性細胞呈血管中心性分布，是淋巴瘤樣肉芽腫的特徵。
features: Dark blue-black EBER-positive nuclei on a pink counterstain
Positive cells concentrated in a ring around and within the wall of a central vessel (angiocentric)
EBER-positive nuclei of small to intermediate size, some larger and irregular
Surrounding tissue shows vacuolated, necrotic-appearing background with fewer positive cells
describe_en: In situ hybridization for EBER shows numerous positive nuclei clustered around and within the wall of a central blood vessel, producing an angiocentric distribution. Positive cells range from small to larger atypical forms, while the surrounding vacuolated, necrotic-appearing tissue contains fewer positive cells. The perivascular concentration of EBV-infected cells is consistent with lymphomatoid granulomatosis, with the B-cell phenotype of positive cells to be confirmed by CD20.

ddx.vs: ENKTL also shows angiocentric EBER-positive cells, but they are CD56- and cytoplasmic CD3-positive and CD20-negative.
PTLD occurs in transplant recipients and usually forms mass lesions or sheets without the characteristic pulmonary angiodestructive pattern.
GPA vasculitis lacks EBER-positive lymphoid cells and features neutrophils, microabscesses, and palisading granulomas.
